# Claude Design — Generated Design System Archive

External artifacts generated by [Claude Design](https://claude.ai/design) from our
source tokens and docs. Snapshotted here for reference, diffing, and
(non-binding) design-tool prototyping. **Not shipped to production.**

Tokens 1:1 with `src/app/globals.css`; alias notes (`primary/interactive/focus`, `layer/surface/field`, `accent-hover`) merged in after review. |

## What's in each snapshot

```
<date>/
├── README.md            ← Claude-authored design system doc (voice, tokens, components)
├── SKILL.md             ← Agent skill entrypoint generated for this system
├── colors_and_type.css  ← Self-contained CSS (tokens + @font-face) for HTML previews
├── assets/              ← Logo marks / wordmarks / OG image (copied from public/brand)
├── fonts/               ← Embedded Geist woff2 for offline preview rendering
├── preview/             ← Design System tab cards (colors, type, spacing, components, brand)
├── public/              ← Brand files re-copied for preview consumption
├── ui_kits/             ← Interactive HTML prototypes — marketing, dashboard, auth
└── uploads/             ← Ancillary uploads Claude stored alongside the project
```

## Source of truth vs. archive

| Topic | Source of truth | This archive |
|-------|-----------------|--------------|
| Color/typography tokens | `src/app/globals.css` (Tailwind v4 `@theme`) | Static CSS mirror in `colors_and_type.css` |
| Visual execution rules | `docs/design/VISUAL_LANGUAGE_V2.md` | Summarized in `<date>/README.md` |
| Dashboard list/nav patterns | `docs/design/DASHBOARD_UX_PRINCIPLES.md` | Illustrated in `ui_kits/dashboard/index.html` |
| Components | `src/components/ui/` (React, TSX) | HTML replicas in `preview/components-*.html` |
| Fonts | `public/fonts/geist/` (vendored woff2) | `fonts/` (embedded for offline previews) |

If the archive contradicts the source of truth, **the source of truth wins**.
Re-generate the archive; do not backport from archive → code.

## Update workflow

1. Open the [Claude Design project](https://claude.ai/design/p/0fa0ef24-cb7d-4167-8fe2-82c3aa8c6d19?via=share)
   (or a new one for a major revision).
2. Make edits and "Download project as .zip".
3. Unzip to `docs/design/external/claude-design-system/<YYYY-MM-DD>/`.
4. Append a row to the Snapshots table above (date · folder · source link · notes).
5. If tokens diverged between this snapshot and `src/app/globals.css`,
   file an issue — decide which side is authoritative before merging.

## Usage boundaries

- **Allowed:** visual reference, token audits, style comparisons, UX QA
  evidence, designer/engineer handoff moodboards.
- **Not allowed:** direct copy-paste of HTML/CSS into `src/` as shipped code.
  Previews use vanilla HTML + static CSS; production is Next.js 16 + RSC +
  Tailwind v4 `@theme` + semantic-token utilities. Always re-implement
  through our component primitives (`src/components/ui/`).
- Vendor-provided font files in `fonts/` are redundant with
  `public/fonts/geist/`. Do not point runtime code at these archive copies.
